subject: [PATCH v8 09/30] mm/debug_vm_pgtable: test PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a test for PMD (Page Map Directory) swap-exclusive helpers to the Linux kernel's debug_vm_pgtable module. The test is designed to catch architectures that have chosen a PMD exclusive bit overlapping with the swap type or offset field, which would otherwise only be detected by data corruption at runtime. The test mirrors existing pte_swap_exclusive_tests() and checks for correct behavior of PMD swap-exclusive helpers in various scenarios. This patch addresses a potential issue where certain architectures may not correctly handle swap-exclusive bits in PMDs.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Identified a missing test for PMD swap exclusivity and suggested adding it to the existing PTE-level tests. The reviewer approved the patch with minor changes.

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch series adds tests for PMD swap-exclusive helpers, which are used to validate the correctness of page table entries in the Linux kernel. The tests mirror existing PTE-level swap exclusive tests and are designed to catch data corruption at runtime. The patch introduces a new function pmd_swap_exclusive_tests() that checks for PMD swap exclusivity.
